info.title: Vouch API
info.description: Generated from packages/contracts. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm contracts:generate`. Every request sends X-App-Version; POSTs send Idempotency-Key unless x-idempotency says otherwise. Clients must ignore unknown response fields.

post.summary: Send a sign-in code to a college email.
post.description: Always answers `{ sent: true }` for an allowed domain, whether or not an account exists, so the endpoint cannot be used to discover accounts. Rate-limited per email, IP and device.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, typically a UUID; reused only for retries of one request.

email.description: College email address; never stored in clear.

deviceId.description: Client-generated install id, for per-device rate limits.

200.description: Send a sign-in code to a college email.

post.summary: Verify the code and sign in, creating the account when needed.
post.description: When the email has no account and `signup` is missing, the response is `SIGNUP_DETAILS_REQUIRED` (only after a correct code, so only the email owner learns it). In that case the code is NOT consumed and does NOT count as a failed attempt: the client calls verify again with the same code plus `signup` until the code expires. `signup` is ignored for existing accounts.

collegeId.description: Required for an ID-card sign-up (any email); ignored for a college email.

200.description: Verify the code and sign in, creating the account when needed.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.
post.description: The refresh token comes from the body (mobile) or the `vouch_refresh` httpOnly cookie (web; `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`, `Path=/v1/auth/refresh`). Reusing a rotated token revokes the whole token family and returns REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED.

get.summary: Message history and gap replay, in seq order.
get.description: Messages are addressed by `(conversationId, seq)`, so this list pages by seq instead of an opaque cursor: pass `nextAfterSeq` back as `afterSeq`. It is null on the last page. To load history backwards (a chat screen opens at the newest message), pass `beforeSeq` instead: the newest `limit` messages before it, in seq order, and `prevBeforeSeq` for the next older page (null at the start). `peerDeliveredSeq` and `peerReadSeq` are the other member’s cursors, for delivery and read states on your own messages.

parameters.name: beforeSeq
parameters.description: Page backwards: messages with seq below this (Phase 13).

200.description: Message history and gap replay, in seq order.

senderId.description: Random public id of a user. Internal user UUIDs are never exposed.

prevBeforeSeq.description: With `beforeSeq`: pass back as `beforeSeq` for older messages (Phase 13).

peerReadSeq.description: The other member’s read cursor (Phase 13). 0 unless both members share read receipts (Phase 14).
